title: Gus and the Van That Grew Taller
synopsis: Gus watches Ms. Pam use a proper vehicle lift to inspect and complete the repair of Aunt Jo's yellow van, and the van goes back to work.
continuity_state: Before: The damaged tire has been set aside and a replacement wheel is prepared, but Aunt Jo's yellow work van is not yet finished. Ms. Pam has a proper repair bay and lift in the Red Door Garage. After: Ms. Pam uses the garage lift to inspect the van, fits and checks the replacement wheel, lowers the van, completes her checks, and returns it to Aunt Jo. The yellow work van is now roadworthy and back with Aunt Jo. The red-door garage and its lift remain established.

related_resources.reason: Supports a linked vehicle-mechanic detail; no tested outcome claims for these stories.
